title: ui-extracting: compose ExtractingPhase component
description: Compose the ExtractingPhase component that orchestrates the extracting phase UI. Integrates progress animation, status messages, and cancellation controls into a cohesive component that manages the user experience during artifact extraction.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL render the extracting phase UI with all subcomponents
THE SYSTEM SHALL coordinate state between progress animation and extraction logic

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL display the ExtractingPhase component with initial state
THE SYSTEM SHALL abort extraction and return to previous phase

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT leave the UI in an inconsistent state
unwanted.because: Users need clear feedback about extraction failures

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT leave orphaned event listeners
unwanted.because: Memory leaks must be prevented on navigation

preconditions: Extraction state must be available from parent context
Progress animation component must be imported and ready
postconditions: All subcomponents are properly wired to extraction state
invariants: Phase state remains synchronized with extraction progress
User can always cancel the extraction

happy: Given extraction phase is active, when component mounts, then progress animation and cancel button are visible
Given extraction completes, when progress reaches 100%, then component triggers transition to next phase
Given extraction is in progress, when user hovers cancel button, then cancel action is clearly indicated
error: Given extraction fails, when error occurs, then component displays error message with retry option
Given extraction times out, when timeout occurs, then component shows timeout error
Given state is corrupted, when component renders, then it gracefully degrades to error state
